"""Check an installed wheel and run native contracts outside the source tree."""

import argparse
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def test_installed_wheel():
  import postgkyl
  from postgkyl import gpython

  gpython.require()
  package = Path(postgkyl.__file__).resolve()
  assert "site-packages" in package.parts, package
  extension = gpython.lib_path()
  assert extension.with_name("libg0core.so").is_file(), extension
  info = gpython.build_info()
  assert info is not None and len(info["gkeyll_commit"]) == 40, info
  print(f"Checking installed native wheel: {extension}", flush=True)


def main():
  argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__).parse_args()
  # Several tests add ../src to sys.path. Copying them ensures that even those
  # tests cannot accidentally import the checkout instead of the wheel.
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="postgkyl-wheel-tests-") as directory:
    tests = Path(directory) / "tests"
    shutil.copytree(ROOT / "tests",
                    tests,
                    ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "generated"))
    shutil.copy2(ROOT / "pyproject.toml", Path(directory) / "pyproject.toml")
    shutil.copy2(__file__, tests / "test_installed_wheel.py")
    subprocess.run([
        sys.executable,
        "-m",
        "pytest",
        "--timeout=120",
        "-q",
        "tests/test_installed_wheel.py",
        "tests/test_gpython_array.py",
        "tests/test_gpython_basis.py",
        "tests/test_gpython_kernels.py",
        "tests/test_gpython_rio.py",
        "tests/test_analytic_observables.py",
        "tests/test_native_quadrature.py",
    ],
                   cwd=directory,
                   check=True)
  subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "check"], check=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
  main()

"""Check an installed wheel and run native contracts outside the source tree."""

import argparse
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def test_installed_wheel():
  import postgkyl
  from postgkyl import gpython

  gpython.require()
  package = Path(postgkyl.__file__).resolve()
  assert "site-packages" in package.parts, package
  extension = gpython.lib_path()
  assert extension.with_name("libg0core.so").is_file(), extension
  info = gpython.build_info()
  assert info is not None and len(info["gkeyll_commit"]) == 40, info
  print(f"Checking installed native wheel: {extension}", flush=True)


def main():
  argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__).parse_args()
  # Several tests add ../src to sys.path. Copying them ensures that even those
  # tests cannot accidentally import the checkout instead of the wheel.
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="postgkyl-wheel-tests-") as directory:
    tests = Path(directory) / "tests"
    shutil.copytree(ROOT / "tests",
                    tests,
                    ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "generated"))
    shutil.copy2(ROOT / "pyproject.toml", Path(directory) / "pyproject.toml")
    shutil.copy2(__file__, tests / "test_installed_wheel.py")
    subprocess.run([
        sys.executable,
        "-m",
        "pytest",
        "--timeout=120",
        "-q",
        "tests/test_installed_wheel.py",
        "tests/test_gpython_array.py",
        "tests/test_gpython_basis.py",
        "tests/test_gpython_kernels.py",
        "tests/test_gpython_rio.py",
        "tests/test_analytic_observables.py",
        "tests/test_native_quadrature.py",
    ],
                   cwd=directory,
                   check=True)
  subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "check"], check=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
  main()
"""Separate native rebuilds from explicit upstream updates using a local remote."""

import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

import pytest

ROOT = Path(__file__).parents[1]


def _git(directory, *args):
  return subprocess.check_output(
      ["git", "-C", str(directory), *args], text=True).strip()


@pytest.fixture
def checkout(tmp_path):
  remote = tmp_path / "remote"
  remote.mkdir()
  _git(remote, "init", "-b", "main")
  _git(remote, "config", "user.name", "Build test")
  _git(remote, "config", "user.email", "build@example.invalid")
  configure = remote / "configure"
  configure.write_text(
      "#!/bin/sh\nmkdir -p build/core\ntouch build/core/libg0core.so\n")
  configure.chmod(0o755)
  _git(remote, "add", "configure")
  _git(remote, "commit", "-m", "Initial source")
  workspace = tmp_path / "workspace"
  scripts = workspace / "scripts"
  scripts.mkdir(parents=True)
  for name in ("build_gkeyll.sh", "update_gkeyll.sh", "gkeyll_config.py"):
    source = (ROOT / "scripts" / name).read_text()
    (scripts / name).write_text(
        source.replace("https://github.com/ammarhakim/gkeyll.git",
                       remote.as_uri()))
  shutil.copyfile(ROOT / "scripts/gkeyll-branch", scripts / "gkeyll-branch")
  shutil.copyfile(ROOT / "scripts/gkeyll-modules", scripts / "gkeyll-modules")
  shutil.copyfile(ROOT / "postgkyl-build.toml",
                  workspace / "postgkyl-build.toml")
  binary_dir = tmp_path / "bin"
  binary_dir.mkdir()
  make = binary_dir / "make"
  make.write_text('#!/bin/sh\nprintf "%s\\n" "$@" > make-args\n')
  make.chmod(0o755)
  env = dict(os.environ, PATH=str(binary_dir) + os.pathsep + os.environ["PATH"])
  for name in ("POSTGKYL_GKEYLL_MODULE", "POSTGKYL_GKEYLL_DIR",
               "POSTGKYL_BUILD_CONFIG"):
    env.pop(name, None)
  # A stale environment override must never restore commit pinning.
  env["GKEYLL_REVISION"] = _git(remote, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
  return workspace, remote, env


def _run(checkout, script="build_gkeyll.sh"):
  workspace, _, env = checkout
  return subprocess.run(["sh", str(workspace / "scripts" / script)],
                        cwd=workspace,
                        env=env,
                        text=True,
                        capture_output=True,
                        timeout=20)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("existing_branch", [None, "old-feature"])
def test_only_explicit_update_follows_main_as_remote_advances(
    checkout, existing_branch):
  workspace, remote, _ = checkout
  if existing_branch is not None:
    _git(remote, "branch", existing_branch)
    _git(workspace, "clone", "--depth", "1", "--branch", existing_branch,
         remote.as_uri(), "gkeyll")
  first = _run(checkout, "update_gkeyll.sh")
  assert first.returncode == 0, first.stderr
  producer = workspace / "gkeyll"
  initial = _git(producer, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
  _git(remote, "commit", "--allow-empty", "-m", "New upstream change")
  latest = _git(remote, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
  assert latest != initial
  second = _run(checkout)
  assert second.returncode == 0, second.stderr
  assert _git(producer, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == initial
  updated = _run(checkout, "update_gkeyll.sh")
  assert updated.returncode == 0, updated.stderr
  assert _git(producer, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == latest
  assert _git(producer, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "HEAD") == "main"
  assert _git(producer, "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref",
              "@{upstream}") == "origin/main"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("local_change", ["dirty", "commit"])
def test_build_preserves_local_changes_and_update_refuses_them(
    checkout, local_change):
  workspace, _, _ = checkout
  first = _run(checkout)
  assert first.returncode == 0, first.stderr
  producer = workspace / "gkeyll"
  configure = producer / "configure"
  changed = configure.read_text() + "# local change\n"
  configure.write_text(changed)
  if local_change == "commit":
    _git(producer, "add", "configure")
    _git(producer, "-c", "user.name=Build test", "-c",
         "user.email=build@example.invalid", "commit", "-m", "Local work")
  before = _git(producer, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
  result = _run(checkout)
  assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
  result = _run(checkout, "update_gkeyll.sh")
  assert result.returncode != 0
  expected = "tracked modifications" if local_change == "dirty" else "local commits"
  assert expected in result.stderr
  assert configure.read_text() == changed
  assert _git(producer, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == before


def test_rebuild_works_without_remote_and_keeps_local_branch(checkout):
  workspace, remote, _ = checkout

"""Execute a resolved managed Gkeyll build without rereading configuration."""

import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def build_gkeyll(plan):
  """Build the selected stack, preserving existing sources and revisions."""
  if plan.mode != "managed":
    raise ValueError("Existing Gkeyll builds must be rebuilt by their owner")
  directory = plan.directory
  if not (directory / ".git").exists():
    subprocess.run(["sh", str(ROOT / "scripts/update_gkeyll.sh")], check=True)
  sparse = subprocess.run(
      ["git", "-C", str(directory), "config", "--bool", "core.sparseCheckout"],
      capture_output=True, text=True)
  if sparse.stdout.strip() == "true":
    subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(directory), "sparse-checkout", "add",
         *(f"/{module}/" for module in plan.modules)], check=True)

  cc = os.environ.get("CC") or "cc"
  lapack_lite = "yes" if plan.lapack_lite else "no"
  print(f"# Configuring gkeyll (CC={cc}, lapack-lite={lapack_lite}, app={plan.module})",
        flush=True)
  subprocess.run(
      ["./configure", f"CC={cc}", f"--use-lapack-lite={lapack_lite}",
       f"--app={plan.module}"], cwd=directory, check=True)
  arch_flags = os.environ.get("ARCH_FLAGS", "")
  jobs = os.environ.get("BUILD_JOBS") or str(max(1, (os.cpu_count() or 2) // 2))
  # Gkeyll's module makefiles resolve BUILD_DIR relative to the checkout.
  build_dir = plan.build_dir.relative_to(directory)
  print(f"# Building {plan.module} and prerequisites", flush=True)
  subprocess.run(
      ["make", plan.module, "LIBRARY_TARGET=library", f"BUILD_DIR={build_dir}",
       f"ARCH_FLAGS={arch_flags}", f"-j{jobs}"], cwd=directory, check=True)
  for module in plan.modules:
    library = plan.build_dir / module / f"libg0{module}.so"
    if not library.is_file():
      raise ValueError(f"expected {library} after build, but it is missing")
    print(f"# Built {library}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
  from gkeyll_config import load_config

  try:
    build_gkeyll(load_config())
  except (ValueError, OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as exc:
    sys.exit(f"error: {exc}")

"""Resolve native build settings for setuptools and the command-line scripts."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

try:
  import tomllib
except ModuleNotFoundError:  # Python 3.10
  import tomli as tomllib

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BuildPlan:
  """Resolved source ownership, module stack, and native build settings."""

  mode: str
  module: str
  modules: tuple[str, ...]
  directory: Path
  build_dir: Path
  allow_prefix: bool
  lapack_lite: bool


def load_config() -> BuildPlan:
  path = Path(
      os.environ.get("POSTGKYL_BUILD_CONFIG",
                     ROOT / "postgkyl-build.toml")).expanduser().resolve()
  with path.open("rb") as stream:
    document = tomllib.load(stream)
  if set(document) - {"gkeyll"}:
    raise ValueError(f"Unknown build configuration section in {path}")
  settings = document.get("gkeyll", {})
  allowed = {"mode", "module", "directory", "build-dir"}
  if not isinstance(settings, dict) or set(settings) - allowed:
    raise ValueError(f"Unknown Gkeyll configuration setting in {path}")
  if any(not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip()
         for value in settings.values()):
    raise ValueError("Gkeyll configuration values must be nonempty strings")
  mode = settings.get("mode", "managed")
  module = os.environ.get("POSTGKYL_GKEYLL_MODULE",
                          settings.get("module", "core"))
  directory = os.environ.get("POSTGKYL_GKEYLL_DIR", settings.get("directory"))
  if "POSTGKYL_GKEYLL_DIR" in os.environ:
    mode = "existing"
  if mode not in {"managed", "existing"}:
    raise ValueError("Gkeyll mode must be managed or existing")
  modules = (ROOT / "scripts/gkeyll-modules").read_text().split()
  if module not in modules:
    raise ValueError("POSTGKYL_GKEYLL_MODULE / module must be one of: " +
                     ", ".join(modules))
  build_dir = settings.get("build-dir")
  if mode == "managed" and (directory is not None or build_dir is not None):
    raise ValueError("directory and build-dir require mode = 'existing'")
  if mode == "existing":
    if directory is None or not directory.strip():
      raise ValueError(
          "POSTGKYL_GKEYLL_DIR / directory must be a nonempty path")
    directory = (path.parent / Path(directory).expanduser()).resolve()
    if build_dir is not None:
      build_dir = (directory / Path(build_dir).expanduser()).resolve()
  else:
    directory = ROOT / "gkeyll"
    build_dir = directory / ("build" if module == "core" else "build/postgkyl-full")
  return BuildPlan(
      mode=mode,
      module=module,
      modules=tuple(modules[:modules.index(module) + 1]),
      directory=directory,
      build_dir=build_dir or directory / "build",
      allow_prefix=mode == "existing" and build_dir is None,
      lapack_lite=module == "core",
  )


if __name__ == "__main__":
  try:
    config = load_config()
    if sys.argv[1:] == ["--mode"]:
      print(config.mode)
    elif sys.argv[1:] == ["--module"]:
      if config.mode != "managed":
        raise ValueError(
            "Existing Gkeyll builds must be rebuilt by their owner")
      print(config.module)
    else:
      raise ValueError("usage: gkeyll_config.py --mode|--module")
  except (ValueError, OSError) as exc:
    sys.exit(f"error: {exc}")

"""Resolve native build settings for setuptools and the command-line scripts."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

try:
  import tomllib
except ModuleNotFoundError:  # Python 3.10
  import tomli as tomllib

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BuildPlan:
  """Resolved source ownership, module stack, and native build settings."""

  mode: str
  module: str
  modules: tuple[str, ...]
  directory: Path
  build_dir: Path
  allow_prefix: bool
  lapack_lite: bool


def load_config() -> BuildPlan:
  path = Path(
      os.environ.get("POSTGKYL_BUILD_CONFIG",
                     ROOT / "postgkyl-build.toml")).expanduser().resolve()
  with path.open("rb") as stream:
    document = tomllib.load(stream)
  if set(document) - {"gkeyll"}:
    raise ValueError(f"Unknown build configuration section in {path}")
  settings = document.get("gkeyll", {})
  allowed = {"mode", "module", "directory", "build-dir"}
  if not isinstance(settings, dict) or set(settings) - allowed:
    raise ValueError(f"Unknown Gkeyll configuration setting in {path}")
  if any(not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip()
         for value in settings.values()):
    raise ValueError("Gkeyll configuration values must be nonempty strings")
  mode = settings.get("mode", "managed")
  module = os.environ.get("POSTGKYL_GKEYLL_MODULE",
                          settings.get("module", "core"))
  directory = os.environ.get("POSTGKYL_GKEYLL_DIR", settings.get("directory"))
  if "POSTGKYL_GKEYLL_DIR" in os.environ:
    mode = "existing"
  if mode not in {"managed", "existing"}:
    raise ValueError("Gkeyll mode must be managed or existing")
  modules = (ROOT / "scripts/gkeyll-modules").read_text().split()
  if module not in modules:
    raise ValueError("POSTGKYL_GKEYLL_MODULE / module must be one of: " +
                     ", ".join(modules))
  build_dir = settings.get("build-dir")
  if mode == "managed" and (directory is not None or build_dir is not None):
    raise ValueError("directory and build-dir require mode = 'existing'")
  if mode == "existing":
    if directory is None or not directory.strip():
      raise ValueError(
          "POSTGKYL_GKEYLL_DIR / directory must be a nonempty path")
    directory = (path.parent / Path(directory).expanduser()).resolve()
    if build_dir is not None:
      build_dir = (directory / Path(build_dir).expanduser()).resolve()
  else:
    directory = ROOT / "gkeyll"
    build_dir = directory / ("build" if module == "core" else "build/postgkyl-full")
  return BuildPlan(
      mode=mode,
      module=module,
      modules=tuple(modules[:modules.index(module) + 1]),
      directory=directory,
      build_dir=build_dir or directory / "build",
      allow_prefix=mode == "existing" and build_dir is None,
      lapack_lite=module == "core",
  )


if __name__ == "__main__":
  try:
    config = load_config()
    if sys.argv[1:] == ["--mode"]:
      print(config.mode)
    elif sys.argv[1:] == ["--module"]:
      if config.mode != "managed":
        raise ValueError(
            "Existing Gkeyll builds must be rebuilt by their owner")
      print(config.module)
    else:
      raise ValueError("usage: gkeyll_config.py --mode|--module")
  except (ValueError, OSError) as exc:
    sys.exit(f"error: {exc}")

"""Execute a resolved managed Gkeyll build without rereading configuration."""

import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

if TYPE_CHECKING:
  from gkeyll_config import BuildPlan

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def build_gkeyll(plan: "BuildPlan") -> None:
  """Build the selected stack, preserving existing sources and revisions."""
  if plan.mode != "managed":
    raise ValueError("Existing Gkeyll builds must be rebuilt by their owner")
  directory = plan.directory
  if not (directory / ".git").exists():
    subprocess.run(["sh", str(ROOT / "scripts/update_gkeyll.sh")], check=True)
  sparse = subprocess.run(
      ["git", "-C",
       str(directory), "config", "--bool", "core.sparseCheckout"],
      capture_output=True,
      text=True)
  if sparse.stdout.strip() == "true":
    subprocess.run([
        "git", "-C",
        str(directory), "sparse-checkout", "add", *(f"/{module}/"
                                                    for module in plan.modules)
    ],
                   check=True)

  cc = os.environ.get("CC") or "cc"
  lapack_lite = "yes" if plan.lapack_lite else "no"
  print(
      f"# Configuring gkeyll (CC={cc}, lapack-lite={lapack_lite}, app={plan.module})",
      flush=True)
  subprocess.run([
      "./configure", f"CC={cc}", f"--use-lapack-lite={lapack_lite}",
      f"--app={plan.module}"
  ],
                 cwd=directory,
                 check=True)
  arch_flags = os.environ.get("ARCH_FLAGS", "")
  jobs = os.environ.get("BUILD_JOBS") or str(max(1, (os.cpu_count() or 2) // 2))
  # Gkeyll's module makefiles resolve BUILD_DIR relative to the checkout.
  build_dir = plan.build_dir.relative_to(directory)
  print(f"# Building {plan.module} and prerequisites", flush=True)
  subprocess.run([
      "make", plan.module, "LIBRARY_TARGET=library", f"BUILD_DIR={build_dir}",
      f"ARCH_FLAGS={arch_flags}", f"-j{jobs}"
  ],
                 cwd=directory,
                 check=True)
  for module in plan.modules:
    library = plan.build_dir / module / f"libg0{module}.so"
    if not library.is_file():
      raise ValueError(f"expected {library} after build, but it is missing")
    print(f"# Built {library}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
  from gkeyll_config import load_config

  try:
    build_gkeyll(load_config())
  except (ValueError, OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as exc:
    sys.exit(f"error: {exc}")
